metadata.description: KISA-based security vulnerability assessment skills. Supports CII (560+ items), AI Security Guide, Robot Security (103 items), Space Security (satellite/GSaaS/supply chain, 53 items), Secure Coding Guide (JS/Python/Pseudo Code, 46 items, 49 CWE), Zero Trust, SW Supply Chain (SBOM), and KISA Boho-nara security notice response (exposure check, briefing, CVE lookup, threat response). Available in English and Korean.
